name: Aeronca Chief (50 / 11AC)
summary: Side-by-side two-seat tube-and-fabric high-wing from Aeronca, the roomier, touring-style sibling of the tandem Champ.

wings: High wing braced by a single strut each side
fuselage: Deep, round-sided cabin with side-by-side seating
Large window area and a wide door
Fabric-covered; oleo-strut main gear with a tailwheel

tellTales: Plump, deep fuselage with two seats side by side
Strut-braced high wing on a small tailwheel aircraft

confusedWith.howToTell: The Chief seats two side by side in a deeper, rounder cabin; the Champ seats two in tandem in a long narrow cabin.
The Chief has a deeper, rounder cabin and fuselage; the Taylorcraft's fuselage is narrower and more angular.
The Chief has side-by-side seats; the Cub has tandem seats and a narrower, squarer roofline.
The Chief is fabric-covered with a single strut; the Luscombe is all-metal with a V-strut.
